why: The shopper asked for the best smart projector, and ChatGPT answered with four standalone projector cards (Nebula X1, Mars 3, Cosmos 4K SE, Horizon 20); it mentions a 100–150-inch screen and outlet power only as viewing conditions, not as items the shopper must buy. The deciding facts are brightness, built-in battery versus AC power, and 4K versus 1080p, which separate models within one product, so the page should compare projectors and recommend one. An Aurzen projector plus its 120-inch screen could share one cart, but treating that as a kit would stretch an optional accessory into one.
